description: Canonical reproducibility descriptor for the persistent MILLOW local chain. Scripts read this file; docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md explains the Computer 1 -> Computer 2 workflow.

node.accounts_flag_reason: Anvil defaults to 10 accounts; the MINTER_ROLE holder is account index 10 (0xBcd4042DE499D14e55001CcbB24a551F3b954096) and does not exist unless --accounts 20 is passed.
node.state_interval_reason: Windows cannot deliver SIGTERM to a detached process, so anvil cannot always dump state on exit. --state-interval bounds state loss to the interval.
node.state_dump_format: anvil_dumpState returns hex-encoded gzip; anvil --state requires plain JSON at the path. The distributed artifact is gzip of that JSON. Note: --state is mutually exclusive with both --dump-state and --load-state in anvil 1.8.3, and --state alone already loads and persists.

mapping_manifest.note: MREID numeric suffix is NOT the token id. 1,396 token ids are intentionally permuted relative to dataset order and must be reproduced exactly. Replay in manifest order to reproduce them.

address_determinism: Anvil's default mnemonic is the same test phrase Hardhat uses, so accounts 0/1/2/3/10 resolve to the same addresses. Deployment from account 0 with a fixed nonce sequence therefore reproduces these addresses byte-for-byte.

state_artifact.distribution_note: Never commit the state artifact to git history. Repo carries only this manifest, the mapping CSV, and the scripts.
state_artifact.verification: Produced by a full production run: 8 deploy + 29135 mint + 29135 transfer = 58278 txs. Full 21/21 audit passed before AND after an Anvil stop/restart from .chain/state.json, with zero deployments and zero mints on the restarted process.
